text:
Maria Lopez: Hey team — noticed last night PagerDuty sent multiple pages for 'redis-pod-restarts' but they routed to infra instead of app oncall. Where do we control PD routing/escalation policies? Also where can I find logs/traces for those incidents (grafana/logs link)?

Jake Turner: The PD routing lives in PagerDuty under Services -> 'redwood-alerting'. Escalation policy is 'ops-escalation' which currently forwards to infra rotation first. Link: https://app.pagerduty.com/services/P12345 (needs PD access) :wave:

Ria Patel: For logs/traces check Grafana Loki dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/abc123/infra-logs and Jaeger traces: https://jaeger.redwood/trace/<trace-id>. For quick replay, run: `kubectl logs -n prod -l app=redis --since=2h` or the convenience script `scripts/infra/fetch_redis_logs.sh <pod>`

Samir Chen: We had a request from Product last week that app teams should own Redis pages. If we want to move routing, we can either change the PD escalation policy (route to apps rotation) or make the alert itself less noisy so it doesn't page. I generally prefer fixing the alert semantics.

Maria Lopez: Where's the alert rule config? I want to reduce sensitivity on 'RedisOOM' flapping. Is it in infra/monitoring repo?

Jake Turner: Yep — infra/monitoring repo: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-monitoring -> alert_rules/redis.yaml
Example snippet from that file:
```yaml
- alert: RedisOOM
  expr: redis_memory_rss_bytes > 800000000
  for: 1m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
If you bump `for:` to `5m` and change `severity` to `warning`, it will avoid paging on short bursts. Please open a small PR and tag @Ria Patel and @oncall-bot for rollout.

Ria Patel: Also add a short runbook note in docs/runbooks/redis.md explaining what to do if it pages and common false positives. Happy to review the PR. :+1:

Maria Lopez: Will do. Quick Q: does changing the rule require a deploy window? I can target next maintenance window if needed.

Samir Chen: It's a config push to the monitoring cluster — usually no full product deploy. We prefer low-traffic hours but small alert tweaks are OK anytime. Tag `monitoring-deploy` in the PR to trigger CI and the deploy job. :rocket:

Jake Turner: If you do want routing changed in PD instead (short-term), open a ticket for security to approve (we sometimes need approval for escalation policy changes). Ping me on the PR and I'll double-check PD levels vs rotation. :eyes:

Maria Lopez: Thanks all — I'll open the PR with the `for: 5m` change and runbook note, and tag you both. If we still get pages after that we can adjust PD routing.

oncall-bot: Reminder: when tagging @oncall-bot include `#monitoring` in PR title to auto-assign the rollout window.

Jake Turner: Thanks — appreciate the quick follow-up.
